content.title: TINY HABITS, BIG {{RESULTS}}
facts: **Drink a glass of water** right after waking up — your brain and body have been dehydrated for hours and this jumpstarts alertness and digestion.
**Take 10 deep breaths** before opening your phone in the morning — it lowers cortisol and sets a calmer tone for the rest of the day.
**Walk for 5 minutes** after every meal — it blunts blood sugar spikes and improves digestion significantly.
**Stretch your neck and shoulders** every hour at your desk — it prevents tension headaches and improves posture over time.
**Step outside for 2 minutes of sunlight** in the morning — it helps regulate your circadian rhythm and boosts mood via serotonin.
**Write down 3 things you're grateful for** before bed — it's linked to better sleep quality and reduced anxiety.
**Chew each bite 20 times** at dinner — it improves digestion and gives your body time to signal fullness, reducing overeating.
